children: Gogo said it completed testing and integration of a modified Galileo HDX high-speed satcom for Insitu’s Integrator Group 3 UAS, enabling global LEO connectivity via Eutelsat OneWeb with a single LRU configuration.
HDX satcom integrated on Integrator UAS
Validates product-market fit in Group 3 UAS, a growing defense segment that can drive equipment and service revenue.
LEO backhaul improves latency and coverage, strengthening Gogo’s service value proposition.
Lower size/weight and simpler installs can speed deployments and improve margins.
Eases international sales frictions, potentially expanding addressable non-U.S. demand.
Reduces execution risk vs. concept-stage announcements; nearer to commercial uptake.

This is an early commercialization step in Gogo’s push into defense UAS connectivity, aligning with its multi-orbit strategy. For a larger catalyst, watch for purchase orders, contract values, or program adoptions by Insitu customers and other Group 3 UAS OEMs.
